title: Vaporesso Xros 4 Nano Pod Vape Kit
description: The Vaporesso Xros 4 Nano Vape Kit is a sleek, powerful device designed for vapers who appreciate both style, functionality and unrivalled portability. Its 1350mAh built-in battery – an incredible feat of engineering for such a compact ‘matchbox-style’ device – ensures outstanding longevity while supporting up to 30W of adjustable power, catering to both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. It also supports fast USB Type-C charging, ensuring a full charge in approximately 30 minutes. This kit includes two 2ml Xros pods equipped with COREX 2.0 technology, enhancing flavour and coil longevity. The 0.6Ω pod is perfect for rich, flavourful RDL vaping, while the 0.8Ω pod offers a crisp and satisfying MTL experience. The Xros pods feature a top-fill design, ensuring mess-free refills, and are fully compatible with all devices in the Xros family. The device offers three useful modes: Eco (preserves battery), Normal (automatically optimises to suit your pod’s coil resistance) and Power (boosts output for more intense flavour). These modes apply to all Xros pods above 0.6hms, while the 0.4ohm RDL pod can be easily adjusted with Variable wattage control. An adjustable airflow slider lets you fine-tune your vape’s draw regardless of which pod you use. The circular 1.3” TFT display, the largest in the Xros series, offers clear, vivid animations and essential vaping information at a glance. Constructed from durable materials and available in multiple stylish colours, the Xros 4 Nano is both robust and visually appealing. Discover our nicotine vape liquid online and enhance your vaping experience with this kit. We recommend using the following E-Liquids with this kit Vaporesso Xros Corex Series Pods 0.6ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids Vaporesso Xros Corex Series Pods 0.8ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquids Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
